item.description:

item.title: Verification Is Not Knowledge: Science needs more than answers
item.description:
📝 The problem is that if we all agree that outputs matter–that we do care about the solutions to longstanding conjectures, that we do ultimately want to know how to cure diseases–then understanding appears as something separate. They are less about anyone’s mental state than about what happens when something goes wrong.
